entities.summary: Yolanda Josefina Andrade Gómez is a Mexican actress and television presenter born in Culiacán, Sinaloa. She started her career at the telenovela Yo no creo en los hombres (1991), along with Gabriela Roel and Alfredo Adame, which allowed her to work in bigger productions such as Las secretas intenciones (1992) with Cristian Castro.
